description: It’s perfect location between Rincon’s best swimming beaches & proximity to the lively downtown plaza ensure you experience the best Rincon has to offer. With 3 spacious bedrooms featuring ultra-comfortable beds & a dedicated workspace, this home offers the perfect balance of relaxation and convenience. Easy access to the beach & thoughtful amenities make it the perfect spot for beach lovers. Whether you’re here to unwind or explore, this home has everything you need for a memorable vacation!The spaceWhether you’re here to unwind or explore, this home has everything you need for a memorable beach vacation.Nestled in the scenic Vista Azul neighborhood, this stylish, modern, and fully-equipped townhome offers the best ocean view in the area right off the back deck. Located just steps from the beach via a private walking trail, it’s the ideal spot for a family getaway.The three spacious bedrooms are designed for ultimate comfort, featuring luxurious beds, soft cotton sheets, and customizable AC and ceiling fans. The master bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom, a private balcony with ocean views, and a work area with high-speed internet. Two additional bedrooms open to an ocean-facing balcony with lounge chairs and sunset views.The open-concept living area boasts a large flat-screen TV, cable, ROKU connectivity, and leather furniture, perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach. The fully-equipped kitchen features new appliances, a breakfast bar, and everything needed to prepare meals, including a coffee maker, blender, and dishwasher. The dining area offers ocean views and seating for six, with French doors leading to a beautiful outdoor terrace.Outside, enjoy two levels of ocean-facing patios, complete with hammocks and plenty of seating. The home comes stocked with everything needed for the beach, including a cooler and beach chairs. With personalized recommendations and around-the-clock host availability, this home is ready to provide an unforgettable beach vacation for you and your family or guests!Guest accessGuests have access to the entire property except for the owner’s closet and the owner keeps a car parked in the carport, but you still have room in the driveway and in the street to park. Guests are free to use the laundry room, although we kindly ask that you provide your own laundry detergent if you will be doing more than one load per stay. We have encountered many unfortunate situations where our guests will leave us without any detergent which is inconvenient when it’s time for us to clean and reset the linens in the house.We have a pack of play in the house with two sets of sheets that is available for use upon request.Other things to noteThank you again for your booking. We truly look forward to having you and we hope that you have an amazing stay at this very special property. ** Please take time to review the listing in its entirety as well as all available amenities. If you would like more specific details about what amenities are available or would like to confirm availability of a specific amenity that you don’t see listed, please write us. Some of the most common items that people ask about are: Is the tap water safe to drink? Due to the high levels of chlorine in the tap water, we recommend all guests purchase bottled water for drinking. However, the water from the tap is safe to use for cooking, showering, brushing, washing hands and also for drinking. The power & water service infrastructure in Puerto Rico can be unstable at times. This particular area of Rincon **IS NOT**subject to frequent power/water outages, but they are a possibility. If you experience an outage of any kind, please try to remain calm and patient because the outages typically don’t last for more than a few minutes or sometimes a few hours. If the power or water are out and you have questions or concerns, please contact us so that we can try to provide you as much detailed information as possible. Please understand that we cannot be held responsible for any outages as we do not have control over the situation, but we will do whatever we can to help ease your stress. In the rare occurrence of an unusually lengthy outage due to a severe storm or other act of nature, we will work together to determine the best course of action.

title: Casa Grande | Private Pool in Best Rincon Location
description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceWelcome to Casa Grande, your ultimate Rincón getaway—a spacious three-level coastal retreat designed for families and groups seeking comfort, style, and the best location in this iconic surf town. This project is not related to our home and does not affect the property or its amenities. However, there may be occasional daytime noise during working hours, approximately between 9:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m.🏠 PROPERTY OVERVIEWCasa Grande comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests across three thoughtfully designed floors—each offering its own living spaces and bedroom areas to ensure privacy and convenience for everyone.✨ First Floor- Fully equipped kitchen- Open dining area- Two (2) bedrooms, each with a private bathroom Bedroom 1: King-size bed Bedroom 2: Full-size bed- Access to the outdoor terrace featuring: Private pool Lounging and dining areas—perfect for true Rincón outdoor living✨ Second Floor- Bright and spacious living room (with TV)- Additional dining area- Second full kitchen- Half bathroom in the hallway- Master bedroom with a King-size bed and private ensuite bathroom- Balcony for enjoying morning coffee or sunset breezes- Washer & dryer conveniently located near the living area✨ Third Floor- Cozy living room (with TV)- Four (4) bedrooms: Three (3) with Queen-size beds One (1) with a Full-size bed- Shared bathroom in the hallway- Private ensuite bathroom in the far right-side bedroom- Balcony with elevated views🛌 SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (7 Bedrooms | 7 Beds)- 2 King beds- 3 Queen beds- 2 Full bedsPACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.🌟 CASA GRANDE FEATURES- Private pool & spacious outdoor terrace (The pool is not heated!)- Two living rooms with TVs (2nd & 3rd floors)- 2 Fully equipped kitchens (1st & 2nd floors)- Washer & dryer (2nd floor)- Dishwasher- Parking for up to 5 vehicles (unassigned)- Automatic Generac backup generator- Water cistern- Smoke alarms, carbon monoxide detectors, fire extinguisher🌊 LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATIONCasa Grande is located in one of the best areas of Rincón, known for its surf culture, vibrant food scene, and stunning beaches. You’re just a short walk from:- Beautiful local beaches- Restaurants & cafés- Bars—including the iconic Tamboo Beachfront Bar & Grill- Everything you need for the perfect Rincón experience is right at your doorstep.GETTING AROUND & PARKINGRenting a car is a must when staying in Rincón. There are many activities within 15-30 minutes of driving distance and the roads are easy to navigate. The villa has room for up to five (5) vehicles. LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at your personal grand terrace and private pool, or just a short walk away from Sandy Beach. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon sunset at Sandy Beach or Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach. or The Beach House.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards. Guests can rent surfing boars at The Beach House.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergent Please note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 14 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.
